New Hero — drop the 20 .otf files in THIS folder, using exactly these names.
(Safe to delete this file once they're in.)

  NewHero-Hairline.otf            NewHero-HairlineItalic.otf
  NewHero-Thin.otf                NewHero-ThinItalic.otf
  NewHero-UltraLight.otf          NewHero-UltraLightItalic.otf
  NewHero-Light.otf               NewHero-LightItalic.otf
  NewHero-Regular.otf             NewHero-RegularItalic.otf
  NewHero-Medium.otf              NewHero-MediumItalic.otf
  NewHero-SemiBold.otf            NewHero-SemiBoldItalic.otf
  NewHero-Bold.otf                NewHero-BoldItalic.otf
  NewHero-ExtraBold.otf           NewHero-ExtraBoldItalic.otf
  NewHero-Super.otf               NewHero-SuperItalic.otf

The files you have are named "New Hero Bold Italic.otf" etc. To rename all 20
at once, cd into this folder and run:

  for f in "New Hero "*.otf; do
    mv "$f" "$(echo "$f" | sed 's/^New Hero /NewHero-/; s/ Italic\.otf$/Italic.otf/')"
  done

Then check they all landed:

  npm run check:fonts

`npm run build` runs that check automatically and refuses to build if any face
is missing — see scripts/check-fonts.mjs for why that guard exists.
